nodes.Name: fmtFlags
nodes.DocComment: flags placed in a separate struct for easy clearing.

nodes.Name: fmt
nodes.DocComment:
A fmt is the raw formatter used by Printf etc.
It prints into a buffer that must be set up separately.

nodes.Name: writePadding
nodes.DocComment: writePadding generates n bytes of padding.

nodes.Name: pad
nodes.DocComment: pad appends b to f.buf, padded on left (!f.minus) or right (f.minus).

nodes.Name: padString
nodes.DocComment: padString appends s to f.buf, padded on left (!f.minus) or right (f.minus).

nodes.Name: fmtUnicode
nodes.DocComment: fmtUnicode formats a uint64 as "U+0078" or with f.sharp set as "U+0078 'x'".

nodes.Name: fmtInteger
nodes.DocComment: fmtInteger formats signed and unsigned integers.

nodes.Name: truncateString
nodes.DocComment: truncateString truncates the string s to the specified precision, if present.

nodes.Name: truncate
nodes.DocComment: truncate truncates the byte slice b as a string of the specified precision, if present.

nodes.Name: fmtBs
nodes.DocComment: fmtBs formats the byte slice b as if it was formatted as string with fmtS.

nodes.Name: fmtSbx
nodes.DocComment: fmtSbx formats a string or byte slice as a hexadecimal encoding of its bytes.

nodes.Name: fmtSx
nodes.DocComment: fmtSx formats a string as a hexadecimal encoding of its bytes.

nodes.Name: fmtBx
nodes.DocComment: fmtBx formats a byte slice as a hexadecimal encoding of its bytes.

nodes.Name: fmtQ
nodes.DocComment:
fmtQ formats a string as a double-quoted, escaped Go string constant.
If f.sharp is set a raw (backquoted) string may be returned instead
if the string does not contain any control characters other than tab.

nodes.Name: fmtC
nodes.DocComment:
fmtC formats an integer as a Unicode character.
If the character is not valid Unicode, it will print '\ufffd'.

nodes.Name: fmtQc
nodes.DocComment:
fmtQc formats an integer as a single-quoted, escaped Go character constant.
If the character is not valid Unicode, it will print '\ufffd'.

nodes.Name: fmtFloat
nodes.DocComment:
fmtFloat formats a float64. It assumes that verb is a valid format specifier
for strconv.AppendFloat and therefore fits into a byte.
